Name: LM Compatibility Level = 5 (NTLMv2 only)
Description: LmCompatibilityLevel=5 refuses LM and NTLMv1 entirely. Anything lower enables downgrade attacks and pass-the-hash.
Rationale: LmCompatibilityLevel=5 refuses LM and NTLMv1 entirely. Anything lower enables downgrade attacks and pass-the-hash.
Remediation: GPO: Network security: LAN Manager authentication level = Send NTLMv2 response only; refuse LM & NTLM. Registry: set HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\LmCompatibilityLevel = 5.

Name: NTLM minimum client security requires NTLMv2 + 128-bit
Description: NtlmMinClientSec should enforce NTLMv2 session security (0x00080000) and 128-bit encryption (0x20000000). Combined = 537395200.
Rationale: NtlmMinClientSec should enforce NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption. Combined = 537395200.
Remediation: GPO: Network security: Minimum session security for NTLM SSP based clients = Require NTLMv2 + 128-bit encryption. Registry: NtlmMinClientSec = 537395200.

Name: NTLM minimum server security requires NTLMv2 + 128-bit
Description: NtlmMinServerSec=537395200 ensures the server side rejects weak NTLM sessions.
Rationale: NtlmMinServerSec=537395200 ensures the server side rejects weak NTLM sessions.
Remediation: GPO: Network security: Minimum session security for NTLM SSP based servers = Require NTLMv2 + 128-bit encryption. Registry: NtlmMinServerSec = 537395200.

Name: WDigest cleartext password caching disabled
Description: UseLogonCredential=1 stores plaintext passwords in LSASS memory. mimikatz sekurlsa::wdigest exploits this. Must be 0.
Rationale: UseLogonCredential=1 stores plaintext passwords in LSASS memory. mimikatz sekurlsa::wdigest exploits this. Must be 0.
Remediation: GPO: MS Security Guide > WDigest Authentication = Disabled. Registry: UseLogonCredential = 0.

Name: LSA RunAsPPL (Protected Process Light) enabled
Description: RunAsPPL=1 runs LSASS as a Protected Process, preventing credential dumping by tools that cannot inject into protected processes without a signed driver.
Rationale: RunAsPPL=1 runs LSASS as a Protected Process, preventing credential dumping by tools like mimikatz.
Remediation: Registry: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL = 1. Requires a reboot to take effect; enable Secure Boot first for kernel-level protection.

Name: Anonymous SAM enumeration restricted
Description: RestrictAnonymousSAM=1 prevents unauthenticated enumeration of local accounts via the SAM pipe used by recon tools.
Rationale: RestrictAnonymousSAM=1 prevents unauthenticated enumeration of local accounts via the SAM pipe.
Remediation: GPO: Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts = Enabled. Registry: RestrictAnonymousSAM = 1.

Name: Anonymous access to named pipes / shares restricted
Description: RestrictAnonymous=1 prevents anonymous connections from enumerating shares and named pipes used by BloodHound-style recon.
Rationale: RestrictAnonymous=1 prevents anonymous connections from enumerating shares and named pipes.
Remediation: GPO: Network access: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares = Enabled. Registry: RestrictAnonymous = 1.

Name: Outbound NTLM traffic restricted or audited
Description: RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic=2 blocks all outbound NTLM; 1 = audit only. Prevents NTLM relay attacks when an attacker triggers outbound auth.
Rationale: RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic blocks or audits outbound NTLM, preventing relay attacks triggered by coerced auth.
Remediation: GPO: Network security: Restrict NTLM: Outgoing NTLM traffic to remote servers = Audit/Deny all. Registry: RestrictSendingNTLMTraffic = 1 (audit) or 2 (block).

Name: NTLM authentication auditing enabled
Description: AuditReceivingNTLMTraffic=2 logs all incoming NTLM auth in the Security event log, essential for detecting NTLM relay/pass-the-hash attempts.
Rationale: AuditReceivingNTLMTraffic logs incoming NTLM auth, essential for detecting relay and pass-the-hash attempts.
Remediation: GPO: Network security: Restrict NTLM: Audit incoming NTLM traffic = Enable auditing for all accounts. Registry: AuditReceivingNTLMTraffic = 2.
